summary: Market Makers discusses two investment cases: biotech company Caleditas facing FDA approval on September 15 for their drug Neficon treating IgA nephropathy, and Dutch semiconductor equipment manufacturer ASML. Both companies are analyzed in detail, with hosts disclosing small personal positions in each.
key_takeaways: Caleditas has 90% historical probability of FDA approval with strong clinical data, but significant downside risk if rejected
ASML holds near-monopoly position in semiconductor lithography equipment with 90%+ market share
Semiconductor shortage is driving increased demand for ASML equipment as new fabs are built
Both hosts disclose personal positions: Fabian owns shares in ASML and Caleditas
